purpose: Honest ledger distinguishing the 18 WB-J4E-* / 20 WB-J4F-* TRACEABILITY REQUIREMENT IDs from the mandatory 55-scenario J4E / 68-scenario J4F BEHAVIOURAL matrix. One requirement ID may need several pytest nodes to reach full scenario coverage; this file is the running proof of that mapping and must never show a requirement as scenario-complete until every scenario under it has its own runnable, executed, genuinely red (pre-fix) or green (post-fix) node.
gap_disclosure: Batches A-C mapped exactly one pytest node per WB-J4E-* traceability ID (18 nodes total). That satisfies traceability-ID coverage but NOT the 55-scenario behavioural matrix, which requires additional scenario variants per requirement (e.g. multiple touch-status permutations under WB-J4E-14, multiple concurrent-insert races under WB-J4F outbox IDs, multiple lease-expiry timings under the J4F lease contract). Those additional scenario nodes have not yet been written. This gap is disclosed here rather than silently closed by treating one node per requirement ID as sufficient.

findings.summary: outbox_worker's poll loop applied ONE market_tzinfo/market_timezone_name to an ENTIRE claimed batch, but claim_next_current_outbox_batch never filtered by market — a claimed batch could contain trades from either market, silently misattributing session-boundary timezone semantics for any row not matching the current loop iteration's assumed market.
findings.verification: Full J4F local matrix (60/60) + full non-PostgreSQL suite (2818/1/0) + PostgreSQL 15+17 CI run 30718595833 all green after the fix.

findings.summary: close_service.py's request_current_report_outbox parameter (implemented + unit-tested in Batch G) was never actually invoked with True from any real call site — the atomic close-to-outbox creation capability was dead code; the background worker had nothing to durably recover from when the close-time synchronous best-effort attempt didn't run or settle.
findings.verification: Same verification set as above; PostgreSQL 15+17 CI run 30718595833 green.
